description: Generate a D&D poetry using the declared prompt and optional structured fields. Entity text is free on every user plan, including Free. This generator does not create a portrait. Partner keys are billed from their wallet. Returns a job_id immediately; poll chargen_get_job for the entity_id and page_url. Pass collection_id to file it into your folder. Generated entries are public by default; change visibility in CharGen.

authorEntityId.description: Optional UUID of your own Character or NPC, for Journal / diary

collection_id.description: Optional folder UUID owned by you; user accounts only. The finished entity is filed there on the first completed chargen_get_job poll.

customContentType.description: Required custom format for contentType Other, up to 100 characters

idempotency_key.description: Optional partner billing deduplication key. Retries with the same key avoid a second wallet debit, but can start another generation.

journalStyle.description: Personal journal or Found journal, for Journal / diary

name: chargen_generate_poetry
title: Generate poetry
